question: does composing row-band removal with a temporal median de-saturate the motion field and make the speech signal stand out more?

empty_flip.unit: fraction of consecutive motion-map pairs, in (0, 1]
empty_flip.definition: NOT MEASURED by this script: the empty capture's flip rate is never computed, so this is null for every variant

empty_saturation.definition: fraction of pixels in the EMPTY capture whose change-map value exceeds 1% of that map's own 99.5th-percentile value

A_flip.unit: fraction of consecutive motion-map pairs, in (0, 1]
A_flip.definition: fraction of consecutive motion-map pairs on condition A whose change exceeds half the maximum change in that run

A_saturation.definition: fraction of pixels on condition A whose change-map value exceeds 1% of that map's own 99.5th-percentile value

A_gap.mean_abs_diff.definition: mean absolute difference between the first and second 6-frame block of condition A's change map (0.8 s to 9.0 s)

A_gap.max_diff.definition: maximum absolute difference between the first and second 6-frame block of condition A's change map (0.8 s to 9.0 s)

A_gap.top5pct_excess_share.definition: share of the excess over the median that falls in the most active 5% of pixels for condition A

B_flip.unit: fraction of consecutive motion-map pairs, in (0, 1]
B_flip.definition: fraction of consecutive motion-map pairs on condition B whose change exceeds half the maximum change in that run

B_saturation.definition: fraction of pixels on condition B whose change-map value exceeds 1% of that map's own 99.5th-percentile value

C_flip.unit: fraction of consecutive motion-map pairs, in (0, 1]
C_flip.definition: fraction of consecutive motion-map pairs on condition C whose change exceeds half the maximum change in that run

C_saturation.definition: fraction of pixels on condition C whose change-map value exceeds 1% of that map's own 99.5th-percentile value

C_gap.mean_abs_diff.definition: mean absolute difference between the first and second 6-frame block of condition C's change map (0.8 s to 9.0 s)

C_gap.max_diff.definition: maximum absolute difference between the first and second 6-frame block of condition C's change map (0.8 s to 9.0 s)

C_gap.top5pct_excess_share.definition: share of the excess over the median that falls in the most active 5% of pixels for condition C

A_vs_C.mean_abs_diff.definition: mean absolute difference between the mean change maps of condition A and condition C over frames 30-270

A_vs_C.max_diff.definition: maximum absolute difference between the mean change maps of condition A and condition C over frames 30-270

A_vs_C.within_condition_split.definition: within-condition control: mean absolute difference between the first and second temporal halves of condition A's change map over frames 30-270

A_vs_C.top5pct_excess_share.definition: share of the excess over the 95th percentile of the null that falls in the most active 5% of pixels (localisation)

limits: two labelled sessions per class; the composition can make a teacher MORE LIKELY to pass its gate but cannot make one pass
the empty capture is later and darker than the occupied ones
the flip rates here are computed on the motion maps, not on the Braille field, so they are not directly comparable to the 50.00% / 0.01% figures in the other documents
